row.note: Add a domain in the panel and the shared HAProxy serves your backend in the private /24 over HTTPS. It is web traffic only; anything else goes through a forwarded port or IPv6.

source.quote: We allow you to add your domains and subdomains to our HAProxy service within the control panel.

row.note: There is no authenticated or tokenised URL in front of a port. The private /24 is server-to-server networking, not a link you can share.

source.quote: TierHive gives you a global meshed /24, and a subnet from 10.0.0.0/8

row.note: A standard SSH client works, but the address is the host's shared IPv4 and the port is a random high one, because the first forwarded TCP port is mapped to the server's 22.

source.quote: By design the 1st TCP port is mapped to your VPS port 22/TCP.

row.note: A browser VNC console in the panel gets you in when SSH is unreachable or a bad network change locks you out.

source.quote: Browser-based noVNC console access

row.note: Nothing in the panel forwards a local port to your laptop. Recipes for Tailscale, Netbird and cloudflared let you build your own overlay, which is a different thing.

source.quote: Make accessing resources within your TierHive CIDR easy as 1-2-3 using Cloudflare Tunnel.

row.shortfall: Each server gets two forwarded TCP ports and SSH takes one, so only one TCP service is reachable from outside unless you use IPv6.
row.note: Ports are mapped in the panel, external to internal, so a database or game server does work on the spare port or on a dedicated IPv6 address, where nearly the full range is open.

source.quote: Your nat VPS is provided with 2 open TCP ports and 2 UDP port.

source.quote: Point your domain's DNS to TierHive's HAProxy endpoints
